subject: CYCLE-2 FINDING: historical Fold7 field trace proves temporary dual-active secondary bridge window; inverse INNER-secondary remains to test
body: Cross-lane reconciliation found direct physical Fold7 evidence in the 2026-09-30 field diagnostics that materially strengthens P0 wake strategy and ticket07. During repeated closing runs with INNER as default logical display 0, Duo executed `cmd display enable-display 1` for the 1080x2520 cover. The command returned ok=true/visibleAfter=true; dumpsys showed both INTERNAL viewports active and both physical DisplayDeviceInfo states ON; Duo resolved innerLogical=0 state=ON + coverLogical=1 state=ON with hostUsable=true and live mirror geometry/hinge updates remained valid. One run at ~6deg also logged post-enable logical power ok=true. Samsung subsequently remapped/removed logical routes as native fold ownership changed, so numeric logical display ids are explicitly unstable and must be rebound by physical geometry/address after every mutation. This is device evidence for a temporary dual-active secondary-content window, but it is NOT external-camera proof of simultaneous visible pixels and does NOT prove the inverse operation needed for current P0 (COVER default + early INNER as secondary). Proposed isolated P0 experiment: on one openingAttempt, retain cover/default/task ownership, physically wake INNER, enumerate disabled/current displays, exact-bind 1968x2184 route to stable physical address, enable/revalidate it as secondary only, attach a Duo-owned diagnostic bridge surface/presentation, and measure FIRST_PRESENTED/FIRST_USEFUL before Samsung native default migration. Fail closed on route remap, generation supersession, privacy/secure content, or missing presentation proof. Do not treat state ON/visibleAfter as useful-pixel success.
